Non-ohos-sdk products enable HTTP_MULTIPATH_CERT_ENABLE. Native HttpClient loads /etc/security/certificates and uses peer verification 1, hostname verification 2 unless an explicit request skip flag is set. The real VerifyTask request does not set that flag.
Resolver reads /etc/hosts before DNS; root-owned temporary test FQDN mapping requires no process-private registry or curl resolve override.

rport device-port host-port creates guest-listener reverse transport to a high host port. It can carry real guest HTTPS requests to an independent root-owned peer without a host privileged 443 listener.
Actual acm CLI creates normal accounts, switches by -i ID and dumps real state. Multiple OS accounts default enabled; multiple_active_accounts=false is distinct from sequential account switching.
